usageNote: 介词短语！用来夸科技的神奇，语气带点感激。跟'because of'类似但更正面，专门说好事！

examples.en: Thanks to technology, we can video call friends across the world for free.
examples.zh: 多亏了科技，我们可以免费和世界各地的朋友视频通话。

examples.en: Thanks to technology, doctors can now detect diseases much earlier.
examples.zh: 借助科技，医生现在能更早发现疾病。
